title: Manna
gist: The bread that fell each morning in the wilderness, enough for the day and no more. In John 6 the crowd cites it as the sign they want; Jesus answers that the true bread from heaven is the one the Father is now giving, and speaks of eating his flesh. The Church sees in the manna a type of the Eucharist.

passages.note: 'He gave them the bread of heaven.'
The crowd and the true bread.
'To him that overcometh I will give the hidden manna.'
